channel.title: Pier & Point · China Basin Park
channel.description: Changes, corrections and dated milestones for China Basin Park (Mission Rock), San Francisco. Every item names its source.

item.title: Correction · China Basin Park: On the China Basin Park timeline, the April 25, 2024 opening…
item.description: On the China Basin Park timeline, the April 25, 2024 opening ceremony used to appear twice, from two tables with different wording; it now appears once. The entry that stays now sets the status to complete, as the removed one did, and keeps the source's "official opening" wording. Dates and statuses are unchanged and no source was dropped. Source: Pier & Point editorial decision.

item.title: Correction · China Basin Park: The Port's June 2026 report lists the '5-acre China Basin Park'…
item.description: The Port's June 2026 report lists the '5-acre China Basin Park' among Phase 1's completed elements; the Port's January 2018 staff report gives 4.4 acres and its February 2025 minutes say 'almost five acres'. The Port's October 2023 memo lists a Phase 1 budget line for the inland park of $39.2 to $40.7 million (revised estimates, not a final cost). That memo also says 'in-water' work was delayed to a later phase; no source read says whether any park shoreline or in-water work remains. Source: https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2026-06/item_11a_mission_rock_phase_2_update_and_port_capital.pdf https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf https://sfport.com/media/10214/download https://www.sfport.com/files/2023-10/101023_8b_mission_rock_budget_port_capital_parcel_lease_amendment_final.pdf.

item.title: Correction · China Basin Park: China Basin Park's opening is now dated April 25, 2024 (the ribbon…
item.description: China Basin Park's opening is now dated April 25, 2024 (the ribbon cutting; April 26 was the article date), the unsupported 'first of Mission Rock's open spaces' was removed, and both entries cite the SF YIMBY articles instead of a bare domain. The map shape's notes now say that the Block K lobe is 139 x 144 ft in the Design Controls (not exactly the traced 139 x 143 ft) and that the Design Controls give no park acreage (the Port's 2018 report says 4.4 acres, the 2019 submittal five, the 2012 table 5.12). The shape is unchanged. Source: SF YIMBY, 2024-04-26 (https://sfyimby.com/2024/04/mision-rock-opens-waterfront-park-starts-leasing-for-verde-san-francisco.html); Port of San Francisco, Mission Rock Design Controls, 2018-04-24 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/2025-07/Mission%20Rock%20Design%20Controls%204.24.18_FINAL_Reduced%20File.pdf); Port of San Francisco, Commission Item 11A staff report, 2018-01-26 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Commission/Item%2011A%20Mission%20Rock%20Approvals%20Staff%20Report%201-26-18FINAL.pdf); Mission Rock Partners, Mission Rock Phase 1 Overview, 2019-07-02 (https://www.sfport.com/sites/default/files/Documents/Item%2011D%20Attachment%201%20Mission%20Rock%20Draft%20Phase%201%20Submittal%20Summary_06%2027%2019_2.pdf); San Francisco Giants with The Cordish Companies, Mission Rock Design + Development Revised Proposal, 2012-03 (https://www.sfport.com/files/2022-01/D4D%20-%20MissionRockMarch12RevProposalDesign.pdf).

item.title: Milestone · China Basin Park: Port staff report says the Developer completed Phase 1… (Jun 9, 2026)
item.description: Port staff report says the Developer completed Phase 1 in 2025 and 'the City has accepted all public infrastructure, including parks, streets, and public utilities within the Phase' (Jun 9, 2026). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2026-06-05.

item.title: Milestone · China Basin Park: Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06… (Feb 11, 2025)
item.description: Port Commission passes Resolutions 25-05 and 25-06 unanimously to accept Phase 1 public infrastructure; staff say 'First is China Basin Park and Port open spaces' and that the park will be 'completely Port owned' (Feb 11, 2025). Source: Port of San Francisco, 2025-02-11.
